cues.text: Rainy day, restless dog? Try three easy indoor games.
One. Hide a few treats and let her sniff them out.
Two. Roll a treat in a towel for a snuffle game.
Three. Practise a short trick, a few minutes at a time.
Little treats still count towards the daily meal.
PETTO helps you log meals and walks.
PETTO. Free on iOS and Android.
